annotations.title: imagepeek: make a favicon set from an image

description: imagepeek: Generate a favicon set from an image. For plain sizes use image_thumbnail. Returns a favicon set from one image: favicon.ico (16, 32, 48 px), favicon-32x32.png, apple-touch-icon.png (180 px, flattened on `apple_background`, white by default), icon-192.png and icon-512.png, plus the HTML <link> snippet and the web-manifest icons; a source under 512 px is upscaled, with a note. The images come back in `images`. Reads PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO and AVIF; other formats and images over 40 megapixels are refused (not charged). Output: base64 `data_base64`, without EXIF, GPS, XMP or IPTC; over 15 MB or 50 megapixels is a 413 (not charged). Images are not logged; a result is kept only with `output` "url" (24 h). Typically 0.5-2 s. Price: USD 0.003. Free: 3 imagepeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/favicon-generator-api.html

auto_orient.description: Apply the EXIF orientation first (default true).
auto_orient.title: Auto Orient

fit.description: Squaring a non-square image: cover (default, centre crop) or contain (padded with background).
fit.title: Fit

image_base64.description: The image as standard or url-safe base64 (at most 10 MB decoded; a data:image/...;base64, prefix is fine); or use url.
image_base64.title: Image Base64

output.description: base64 (default): the file comes back inline as base64. url: the file is stored for 24 hours and the reply carries a download link (url, expires_at, bytes, content_type, sha256) instead of the base64, which keeps the file out of your context window.
output.title: Output

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image (at most 10 MB; private, internal and IP-literal hosts are refused); or use image_base64.
url.title: Url
